faq.what_is_answer: Cortar Carrossel is a free online tool to cut Instagram carousels, trim posts and split images into infinite carousels without downloading anything. Just upload your photo, choose rows and columns in the 2×2, 3×3 or 4×5 configurations and download the slices ready for the feed, stories and other social networks.
faq.how_to_use: How do I use Cortar Carrossel?
faq.how_to_use_answer: Upload an image, choose the number of rows and columns, then click "Split Image". You can download the ready slices in seconds.
faq.is_free_answer: Yes. There are no signups, subscriptions, or watermarks — usage is unlimited and completely free.
faq.which_platforms: Which formats, sizes, and file weights are supported when cutting a carousel?
faq.which_platforms_answer: We support JPG, PNG, WebP, and GIF up to about 20 MB (the practical browser limit). It works well with square, vertical, or horizontal social images, but any size is accepted as long as your device can handle it.
faq.best_dimensions: Is Cortar Carrossel safe for my images?
faq.best_dimensions_answer: Yes. Everything runs in your browser: nothing is uploaded or stored on servers. That keeps personal projects, client assets, and confidential material private.
faq.puzzle_post: Can I use Cortar Carrossel as an online image divider or carousel splitter for other networks?
faq.puzzle_post_answer: Absolutely. Beyond Instagram, it works as an online image divider for Facebook, TikTok, Pinterest, or any platform that needs carousel sliders. Pick the grid, download the files, and adapt them to feeds, stories, reels, or sliders with no extra setup.
faq.marketing: Can I use Cortar Carrossel for different projects (posts, reels, sites, presentations)?
faq.marketing_answer: Yes. Even though it focuses on splitting images/carousels, it’s versatile: split photos for posts, reels, website sliders, presentations, or printed material. Split the carousel online, download the pieces, and apply them anywhere.
faq.safe_images: How do I cut an Instagram carousel online without installing anything?
faq.safe_images_answer: Upload the photo to Cortar Carrossel, choose rows and columns (2×2, 2×3, 3×3, 4×5, or longer sequences like 4×1/5×2), and click "Split Image". Every part comes out ready for feed, stories, or reels without losing quality.
faq.file_formats: Is there a site to cut carousels online (including infinite carousels)?
faq.file_formats_answer: Yes. Cortar Carrossel runs in the browser and cuts both standard and infinite carousels. Set a continuous layout (e.g., 4×1, 5×2), preview it, and download the files for sliders, web pages, or endless swipe posts.
faq.size_limit: Is the carousel cutter really free and registration-free?
faq.size_limit_answer: It is completely free. No login, subscription, or watermark. Use the carousel cutter and image divider as many times as you want for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, or LinkedIn.
faq.registration: How do I cut a carousel image or split an image into 2×2 or 3×3?
faq.registration_answer: Adjust "Rows" and "Columns" to create the exact grid. Split into 2×2 for quick posts, 3×3 for puzzle feeds, 1×5 for story sequences, or any custom combo to divide images, cut carousel photos, or slice equal pieces.
faq.watermarks: Can I download each piece separately or everything as a ZIP?
faq.watermarks_answer: Yes. "Download Images" creates a ZIP with every slice, and each thumbnail has its own download icon to save a single slide. Cut a carousel post online and grab only the part you need.
faq.mobile_use: Can I use Cortar Carrossel to split images for A4 sheets or multiple screens?
faq.mobile_use_answer: Cortar Carrossel splits the image into equal pieces; afterward you manually arrange each file to print on A4 sheets or display on different screens/monitors. We don’t rearrange automatically — you choose the grid and build the final layout in your editor.
